cases.case: No recognized Anneal annotations in selected targets
cases.source_behavior: scan_workspace returns no packages; prepare_and_run logs 'Nothing to verify.' and returns Ok(None) before validation, Charon, Aeneas, or Lean.
cases.coverage_consequence: No proof obligation is constructed for the selected targets.

cases.source_behavior: The scanner records the annotated item and a start_from root; Charon receives the sorted roots via --start-from, and Anneal generates Lean only for collected annotated items.
cases.coverage_consequence: The annotated item becomes an explicit proof/specification root; Charon may additionally translate transitive semantic dependencies.
cases.failure_mode: not a totality check for the rest of the crate

cases.case: Unannotated callee reachable from an annotated root
cases.source_behavior: The callee can enter Charon through semantic reachability from --start-from even though the Anneal scanner did not collect an annotation for it.
cases.coverage_consequence: Reachability can put the callee in LLBC/Aeneas output, but Anneal does not synthesize a user specification or proof obligation for the callee merely because it is reachable.
cases.failure_mode: translation coverage must not be confused with explicit unsafe-contract coverage

cases.case: Unannotated item outside every annotated root's semantic closure
cases.source_behavior: The item contributes no scanner root, and custom --start-from limits Charon to the selected roots and their semantic dependencies.
cases.coverage_consequence: The item is outside this Anneal verification run's theorem domain.
cases.failure_mode: silent with respect to annotation completeness

cases.case: Unannotated unsafe leaf reachable from an annotated root
cases.source_behavior: Only functions carrying an unsafe(axiom) Anneal block are explicitly passed to Charon as --opaque by Anneal; an unannotated unsafe callee is not automatically converted into an Anneal axiom/specification.
cases.coverage_consequence: Its treatment depends on Charon/Aeneas support and opacity behavior rather than an Anneal-authored proof of the unsafe contract.
cases.failure_mode: possible trust/translation boundary without explicit Anneal contract

cases.case: Misspelled or omitted 'anneal' token in a doc-code-block info string
cases.source_behavior: parse_anneal_info_string returns Ok(None); parse_anneal_block_common treats the block as unrelated documentation and continues scanning without an Anneal diagnostic.
cases.coverage_consequence: The intended annotation can disappear from the verification root set.
cases.failure_mode: fail-open with respect to the author's intended coverage; if no other annotations remain, verification can become the warning-only successful no-op

cases.source_behavior: Unsupported attributes, including malformed unsafe forms, produce a parse error.
cases.coverage_consequence: The malformed recognized block is not silently accepted.

cases.case: Recognized Anneal block with malformed/unknown clause syntax
cases.source_behavior: The indentation-sensitive body parser rejects invalid structure/keywords and emits diagnostics such as 'Did you misspell a keyword?'.
cases.coverage_consequence: Typos inside a recognized block generally fail before verification proceeds.

cases.case: Missing proof material inside an otherwise recognized spec
cases.source_behavior: This is governed by validate/generation/Lean behavior, including autoParam fallback for some named obligations and the --allow-sorry escape hatch.
cases.coverage_consequence: This is proof-completeness behavior inside an already selected root, not annotation-totality behavior.
cases.failure_mode: separate from this report's root-coverage question

overall_conclusion: Retained Anneal V1 is an opt-in verifier rooted at recognized annotations. It has local fail-closed parsing for many malformed recognized blocks, but it does not establish crate-wide unsafe annotation totality and can silently lose an intended root when the identifying 'anneal' token is absent or misspelled.
